German terms: Regulative, Regulierungs- und Aufsichtsgewalt

Different from the Executive such that it does not feature oligarchs; different from Oversight as it is not about controlling and investigating but about approval and permission granting.

Examples: Bundesnetzagentur, Kartellamt.
